payload.title: Optional L4: dynamic retrieval D on the final slice (bound ~700)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Check whether dynamic retrieval clearly wins on multi-class.

## Scope

Arm D on the final slice only; only if the owner asks and the cumulative cap allows.

## Request bound and cost cap

Bound ~700 Jev requests (use the printed bound). Cap: ~$0.70; cumulative must stay <= $10. Fresh ledger for this stage; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class. Counts toward the hard cumulative cap of $10.

## Stop-point checks

Owner go recorded; cumulative spend checked.

## Definition of done

D row added to the final table with the paired bootstrap.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
